key.name: server-url
key.description: Base URL of the ft_gnome server. Must be https://, except for localhost.

key.name: device-name
key.description: Name this computer is registered under. Empty uses the host name.

key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often to refresh data from the server.

key.name: show-logtime
key.summary: Show today's logtime in the panel
key.description: Show today's logtime next to the icon.

key.name: show-week
key.summary: Show this week's logtime in the panel
key.description: Show the total logtime since Monday next to the icon.

key.name: show-next-eval
key.summary: Show the next evaluation in the panel
key.description: Show the time of the next evaluation next to the icon.
